# Alex Yakir

> Craft-driven designer and systems thinker. 14 years shaping human-computer interaction. Deep frontend expertise with a focus on signal over noise.

## About

A designer at heart, rooted in typography, who went all in on engineering. Works across interaction design, design systems, and frontend craft. 

## Areas of expertise

- Design systems and design engineering
- Interaction design and motion
- Frontend craft
- Figma plugins and design tooling
- Teaching design and frontend
